description: The account balance (what it can pay now, what the running machines cost per hour, when the money runs out, whether rentals are paused and whether auto-recharge tops it up from a saved card) and this token's spend cap: the limit, what is committed, what is left, the longest rental allowed and when the token expires. Call it before long jobs and whenever an alert mentions the balance. Free; changes nothing.
name: get_balance
title: Balance and spend cap
